instruction: Two-Storey House IFC This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a metric IFC4 two-storey house with named ground-floor and first-floor spaces, an upper floor slab with a stair opening, and a roof slab, then save the required output as result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 7 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, 1 IfcDoor, 5 IfcWindow entities, 7 IfcOpeningElement entities, 7 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, and 6 IfcRelFillsElement relationships. 4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities. 5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 6. The IfcBuildingStorey names are exactly Ground Floor and First Floor after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. 7. The IfcSpace names are exactly Living, Kitchen, Dining, Entry, Bedroom 1, Bedroom 2, and Bath after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. 8. The IfcSpace geometry has these world-coordinate plan spans with tolerance +/-0.10 m: Living X = 3.60 m and Y = 3.80 m, Kitchen X = 3.20 m and Y = 2.00 m, Dining X = 3.20 m and Y = 1.80 m, Entry X = 3.60 m and Y = 1.00 m, Bedroom 1 X = 3.40 m and Y = 4.80 m, Bedroom 2 X = 3.40 m and Y = 2.80 m, Bath X = 3.40 m and Y = 2.00 m. 9. The three IfcSlab names are exactly Ground Slab, First Floor Slab, and Roof Slab after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. 10. The slab geometry has these minimum world Z coordinates: Ground Slab at least 0.00 m, First Floor Slab at least 3.20 m, and Roof Slab at least 6.20 m. 11. Each IfcWall geometry has height 3.00 m with tolerance +/-0.10 m. 12. The Main Entrance IfcDoor has OverallWidth 0.95 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m and fills exactly one IfcOpeningElement that voids the IfcWall named GF South. 13. These IfcWindow OverallWidth values are required with tolerance +/-0.05 m: GF North West Window = 1.20 m, GF North East Window = 1.20 m, GF East Window = 1.20 m, FF North West Window = 1.20 m, FF North East Window = 1.20 m. 14. GF North West Window, GF North East Window, GF East Window, FF North West Window, and FF North East Window each fill exactly one different IfcOpeningElement voiding the IfcWall named GF North, GF North, GF East, FF North, and FF North respectively. 15. The IfcOpeningElement named Stair Opening voids the IfcSlab named First Floor Slab and has no IfcRelFillsElement relationship. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
